            comps.append((color, cells))

    # Find the L-shaped indicator: two full perpendicular arms meeting at a corner.

            if s == arm:

                break

        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    _, marker_color, marker_cells, cr, cc, dr, dc = max(markers)
    marker_set = set(marker_cells)

    # The selected object lies in the open quadrant opposite the L's two arms.
    candidates = []
